page_title: HOF 3-1 RBL | Hoffenheim v RB Leipzig 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+6' Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90+4' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Oliver Baumann has no trouble gathering it.
90+3' A pass from Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
90+3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

90+3' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
90+2' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) has tested the patience of referee Patrick Ittrich and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
89' None of the Hoffenheim players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
88' The free kick from close range, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
88' It is time for a substitution. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) is on for Ridle Baku.
88' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) replacing Antonio Nusa.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) coming on for Grischa Promel.
87' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bernardo.
86' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Hoffenheim.
86' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
84' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The RB Leipzig players look gutted.
83' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich has indicated he is going to review the RB Leipzig goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

82' GOAL! Superb work from Christoph Baumgartner, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig), who beats Oliver Baumann with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:2.

79' 3 - 1 Goal! Fisnik Asllani slips a clever pass through to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the left side of the goal. 3:1.
79' Flag goes up against Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
77' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
77' The attendance for today's match is 26561.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) for Tim Lemperle.
75' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Bazoumana Toure and he is replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) is replacing Nicolas Seiwald.
72' A yellow card for bad language! Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
67' The game has come to an end for Assan Ouedraogo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
67' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Yan Diomande will be replaced by Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig).
67' Here comes a substitution. Andrej Kramaric is given a rest as he is replaced by Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim).
65' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is able to continue to play.
61' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) picks up an injury.
61' That's unlucky! David Raum (RB Leipzig) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

59' RB Leipzig slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
56' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.
54' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Patrick Ittrich no option but to blow his whistle.

50' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar.
49' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) jumps into a tackle and Patrick Ittrich signals a foul. RB Leipzig have a free kick.
49' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
48' RB Leipzig take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' David Raum (RB Leipzig) accepts a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot towards the goal, but he only hits the left post! What an unlucky moment for him.
46' The whistle blows and Patrick Ittrich starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
41' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' 2 - 1 Goal! Vladimir Coufal swings the ball deep into the box and finds Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
38' It seemed like Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
38' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
33' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) but poses no threat.

29' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the left side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
29' A lofted cross from Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
27' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
26' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take the corner.

25' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
25' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) brings an opponent down and Patrick Ittrich interrupts the game.
24' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Wouter Burger picks out Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 1:1.
20' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
20' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
19' Looks like Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
16' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up to send the ball in.
12' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Assan Ouedraogo sets up Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
8' A clever short pass gives Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
6' Yellow card. Bernardo (Hoffenheim) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
6' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will officiate today.
